Violet hollow rings are handholds: centering a hand at (316,172) makes it nest exactly; then selecting the opposite hand leaves the ring-side hand visibly dark and anchored. Progress does not count a grip itself. Cave black is likely traversable; tiled gray is wall. Navigation/inchworm objective likely move through a boundary exit, using holds. Current level starts from bottom opening around x192-319 and has top openings x168-263 and x328-431; one ring at (316,172).

Core mechanics:
- Black is navigable; gray/cyan tiled regions are obstacles. Flower sprite needs ~24 px clearance; colored rings/decoys are nonblocking. Clicks too close to/inside the current white flower can be ignored.

- Goal: center every colored hub in the hollow ring with the identical color/pattern simultaneously. A scene increments progress only when its last hub aligns; other rings are decoys. For n endpoints, final coordinate sums must equal n*target center. Route intermediate centroids/arms around obstacles and other structures.
- Render cells are 8 px; logical click coordinates used in centroid arithmetic work directly.
